character_book.name: Locations and Information
character_book.description: Locations and Information of the Fortnite Chapter 1 Island.

entries.name: Named Locations
entries.content: Named Locations and POIs refer to the main locations on the map, the most popular spots for players to drop at.

entries.name: Unnamed Locations
entries.content: Unnamed Locations refer to locations that are important, but aren't important enough to be named. They have no drop rates and only low-tier loot.

entries.name: Drop Rates
entries.content: Drop Rates refers to how many people go to areas. Ranging from very low having little-to-no players, all the way up to insanely high with maximum amounts of players.

entries.name: Loot Tiers
entries.content:
Loot Tier refers to the quality of loot. Low-Tier locations have "common" (gray), and "uncommon" (green) loot. Medium-Tier locations have "rare" (blue), and "epic" (purple) loot. High-Tier locations have "epic" (purple), and "legendary" (orange) loot. Ultra-Tier locations have "legendary" (orange), and "mythic" (gold).

The color of the rarity goes with the item. If you get a Mythic shirt, it we be the color gold, if you get a Rare rifle, it will be the color blue. This goes for all clothes/armors and all weapons.

entries.name: Biomes
entries.content: Biomes refer to the type of terrain that the location is in. There is: mountains with dark green grass and light trees spreaded around, plains with light green grass and trees here-and-there, snow with thick white snow and groups of pine scattered around, desert with little life and cactus all around, swamp with marshy mud and large willow trees, jungle with thick jungle trees and wet muddy ground, and the woods biome with thick trees and large pines.

entries.name: Salty Springs
entries.content: Salty Springs is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small town that has a few houses in the plains biome. It has really high drop rates and medium-tier loot. It has four two-story houses, one single story house, and a gas station. On the outskirts of town there is a small ranger tower, and a camping station.

entries.name: Fatal Fields
entries.content: Fatal Fields is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a rural farm area that has few buildings. It has really low drop rates and low-tier loot. It has one three-story barn, one stables, one two-story farmhouse, six sheds, two grain silos, and three large wheat fields.

entries.name: Pleasant Park
entries.content: Pleasant Park is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small town in the mountain biome. It has high drop rates and has high-tier loot. It has six two-story houses, one single-story house, a gas station, a soccer field, a shed on the soccer field, and a gazebo in the park in the center.

entries.name: Dusty Depot
entries.content: Dusty Depot is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small warehouse and factories down the road in the plains biome. It has high drop rates and has low-tier loot. Dusty Depot has 3 main warehouses, one red, one white, and one blue. One the outskirts of Dusty Depot there is a small factory location that has three factory buildings.

entries.name: Greasy Grove
entries.content: Greasy Grove is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small town with multiple fast food locations in the snow biome. It has high drop rates and medium-tier loot. Greasy Grove has one restaurant named "Durrr Burger," one restaurant named "Guaco's tacos," one gas station, one two-story camping supplies store, four two-story houses, one single-story house, one small gazebo, one small playground, one transformer, and one basketball court.

entries.name: Loot Lake
entries.content: Loot Lake is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small house in an island in the middle of a lake, and small factories on a dock to the side of the lake in the mountain biome. It has low drop rates and high-tier loot. Loot lake has two small two-story factories on a dock leading to the island, one three-story house on an island in the middle of the lake, and one small cave underneath the house on the island.

entries.name: Tomato Town
entries.content: Tomato Town is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small restaurant-themed service area in the plains biome. It has medium drop rates and low-tier loot. Tomato Town has one two-story restaurant named "Uncle Pete's Pizza Pit" or for short just "Pizza Pit," one gas station, one small unnamed taco stand, one really small garage/auto shop, and a two-story house behind the Pizza Pit.

entries.name: Wailing Woods
entries.content: Wailing Woods is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a thick forest biome with a small hideout. It has really low drop rates and low-tier loot. Wailing Woods only has one building, a small two-story makeshift hideout surrounded by a large hedge maze.

entries.name: Lonely Lodge
entries.content: Lonely Lodge is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small lodging area surrounded by light forest in the woods biome. It has low drop rates with low-tier loot. It has one large two-story cabin, four small single-story lodges, and a very large firewatch tower.

entries.name: Retail Row
entries.content: Retail Row is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a shopping town with a strip mall in the plains biome. It has high drop rates, and medium-tier loot. Retail Row has one grocery store called "NOMS," one strip mall consisting of (in order of left to right): [one two-story camping equipment store, one single-story halloween decoration store, one two-story book store named "McGuffin's Book Store," and one bar named "Joel's"], five two-story houses, one unnamed taco stand, one transformer, one basketball court, and multiple large parking lots in front of NOMS and the strip mall.

entries.name: Flush Factory

entries.name: Junk Junction

entries.name: Haunted Hills

entries.content: Tilted Towers is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a large city located in between the mountains and plains biomes. It has insanely high drop rates and ultra-tier loot. Tilted Towers has one small single-story pawn shop with a hidden bunker beneath, one three-story apartment complex, two two-story apartment complexes with two buildings each, one small single-story café, one small single-story garage with a parking lot, one small park, one three-story apartment complex with a built-in taco stand, one five-story unfinished building with a medicine store on the lowest floor, one three-story apartment complex, one six-story apartment complex, one ten-story company building with a "Pizza Pit" pizza store, and a "McGuffin's" book store on the lowest floor, one tall clock tower, one newspaper stand, one large park, one soccer field, and one four-story insurance building.

entries.name: Shifty Shafts
entries.content: Shift Shafts is a POI / named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a mine located in the mountains biome. It has medium drop rates and medium-tier loot. It has many winding tunnels with minecart tracks, one administration building, and two sheds.

entries.name: Lucky Landing
entries.content: Lucky Landing is a POI / named location on the Fortnite Island. It is an Asian-themed  village located in the mountains biome. It has low drop rates and low-tier loot. It has one large park with a large sakura tree in the middle, one unnamed noodle shop, two one-story stores, one watch tower, one three-story hotel, and one two-story house.

entries.name: Paradise Palms
entries.content: Paradise Palms is a POI / named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a tropical city located at an oasis in the desert biome. It has high drop rates and high-tier loot. Paradise Palms has one six-story hotel resort with a large pool, one two-story car dealership, one two-story electronics shop, one small public pool, one medium sized plaza, five two-story vacation homes, and one two-story office building.

entries.name: Lazy Links
entries.content: Lazy Links is a POI / named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a golf course / country club located in the plains biome. It has medium drop rates and medium-tier loot. Lazy Links has one two-story club house, one three port golf cart garage, one large pool, one large parking lot, three tennis courts, one golf equipment shop, one small single-story groundskeeper's house, and multiple golfing areas.

entries.name: Frosty Flights
entries.content: Frosty Flights is a location on the Fortnite Island. It is an airbase located in the snow biome. It has medium drop rates and medium-tier loot. Frosty Flights has one large runway, three plane hangars. and three two-story buildings where the maintenance crew lives and works at.

entries.name: Polar Peak
entries.content: Polar Peak is a POI / named location on the Fortnite Island. It is an ancient castle located on the top of a large mountain in the snow biome. It has high drop rates and ultra-tier loot. Polar Peak has one four-story large castle tower, and three two-story houses outside of it, all made of gray bricks.

entries.name: Happy Hamlet
entries.content: Happy Hamlet is a POI / named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a Christmas village located in the snow biome. It has medium drop rates and medium-tier loot. It has many medieval Christmas themed multi story houses with a large clocktower in the center of the town.

entries.name: Risky Reels
entries.content: Risky Reels is a POI / named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a drive-in theater located in the plains biome. It has high drop rates and high-tier loot. It has one small gazebo, one two-story filming building that houses the projector, one large screen for movies, and a ticket booth at the entrance.

entries.name: Sunny Steps
entries.content: Sunny Steps is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is an ancient Mayan village located in the jungle biome. It has low drop rates and medium-tier loot. It has a large temple, with three two-story housing buildings surrounding it.

entries.name: Lazy Lagoon
entries.content: Lazy Lagoon is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a pirate village located in the jungle biome. It has high drop rates and medium-tier loot. It has a large pirate ship docked at the village, and three two-story buildings just on the docks.

entries.name: Pressure Plant
entries.content: Pressure Plant is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a power plant built inside of an inactive volcano located in the jungle biome. It has high drop rates and high-tier loot. It has multiple two-story futuristic factory buildings and even houses a giant mech built underneath inside the actual volcano itself.

entries.name: Mega Mall
entries.content: Mega Mall is a POI / Named location on the Fortnite Island. It is just a giant mall located in the plains biome. It has insanely high drop rates and ultra-tier loot. Mega mall is a two-story large mall with multiple different types of stores inside, and a food court.

entries.name: Starry Suburb
entries.content: Starry Suburb is a POI / named location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small town with a few houses. It has low drop rates and medium-tier loot. Starry Suburb has two two-story houses and two three-story houses.

entries.name: Containers
entries.content: Containers or Shipment Yard is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It refers to a big area with a bunch of industrial containers containing random things.

entries.name: Soccer Stadium
entries.content: Soccer Stadium is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It is a large soccer stadium.

entries.name: Ruins
entries.content: Ruins is a series of unnamed locations on the Fortnite Island. Ruins are houses or small groups of houses that are in shambles and falling apart.

entries.name: Viking Village
entries.content: Viking Village is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It is the only unnamed location with medium-tier loot. It is a small Norse Viking village on a mountain that has a few single story houses, and a large Norse Viking ship.

entries.name: NIghtclub
entries.content: Nightclub is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It is a small nightclub in an abandoned factory that blares loud music.

entries.name: Prison
entries.content: Prison is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It is the only unnamed location with high-quality loot. It is a two-story prison with a basketball court surrounded by four big walls.

entries.name: Motel
entries.content: Motel is an unnmaed location on the Fortnite Island. It is a single-story run down motel with a few rooms and an empty pool.

entries.name: GUS
entries.content: Gus is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It is a paved race track with a few viewing stands and garages.

entries.name: Oasis Rest Stop
entries.content: Oasis Rest Stop is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It is a gas station, truck stop, and convenience store next to a small oasis in the desert.

entries.name: Hero Mansion
entries.content: Hero Mansion is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It is a three-story mansion with a basement that was used as a movie set for a superhero movie. It still has all it's props.

entries.name: Villain Lair
entries.content: Villain Lair is an unnamed location on the Fortnite Island. It is a secret base inside of a mountain that was used as a movie set for a superhero movie. It still has all it's props, including a large rocket ship replica.
